sql: SELECT count(customer_id) AS n FROM shop.customer
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN region_code = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n FROM shop.customer
SELECT region_code, count(customer_id) AS n FROM shop.customer GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM shop.transfer WHERE year(transfer_date) = 2024 AND month(transfer_date) = 1
SELECT sum(t.amount) AS total FROM shop.transfer t
SELECT c.region_code, count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers, count(*) AS accounts FROM shop.account a JOIN shop.customer c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT h.order_id, (SELECT x.customer_name FROM shop.customer x WHERE x.customer_id = h.legacy_customer_id) AS name FROM shop.order_header h WHERE h.order_id = 7
SELECT h.order_id, (SELECT x.customer_name FROM shop.customer x WHERE x.customer_id = h.legacy_customer_id) AS name FROM shop.order_header h WHERE h.order_id = 8
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM shop.order_line l WHERE l.order_id IN (SELECT o.order_id FROM shop.order_header o JOIN shop.customer c USING (customer_id) WHERE c.region_code = 'W')
SELECT 'ZQXROW' AS tag, count(supplier_id) AS n FROM shop.supplier

SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM shop.order_header o JOIN shop.order_line l USING (order_id) WHERE l.product_id = 0 AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM shop.customer WHERE region_code = 'N') ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(account_id) AS n FROM shop.account
SELECT product_id, count(*) AS n, sum(qty) AS q FROM shop.order_line WHERE product_id < 9 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(customer_id) AS n FROM shop.order_header
SELECT avg(l.product_id) AS avg_product FROM shop.order_line l
SELECT sum(CAST(t.amount / 7 AS DECIMAL(18,5))) AS s FROM shop.transfer t
SELECT CAST(min(order_date) AS TIMESTAMP) AS earliest FROM shop.order_header
